items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had Red Richards and Charlie Smith and I just don't remember who was on the base, but we had I think Joe Barafaldi, myself - so it would be three colored guys and myself in this thing

ctx.x: and Detroit and many places with an organized band, which was always tough to get because, as everyone knows, there are a lot of musicians that are very good that don't want to leave New York and you couldn't get them to go on theroad. So, almost every band I had at that time, was different - almost every band I took out was different; then I was beginning also to find that I'd take a band out for say two weeks - four weeks - then hit another place for two weeks - like Cleveland and those kind of places, then I'd…
